Open a recording (any format dspk-io reads) and report its layout and read speed

```text
dspk open [OPTIONS] <PATH>
```

**Arguments**

- **`<PATH>`**  
  Recording (SpikeGLX .bin / .cbin, raw .bin + JSON .meta, NWB, Zarr)

**Options**

- **`--read-sec <READ_SEC>`**: default `10`  
  Seconds of every channel to read for the throughput test
